name: Balve (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of white, blue and white with a broad blue middle stripe, charged at the centre with the city arms of Balve (a black and white quartered field with an eagle).
history: Municipal flag of Balve; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Balve arms — quartered field with eagle
